entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for a pair of road cycling shoes I bought about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. They're great cycling shoes, but I've been getting terrible blisters on my heels after any ride longer than an hour. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but the fit just isn't working for me.

I'm very sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order. Yes, I see it here. It looks like the delivery was 37 days ago.
That sounds about right. So, can I get a refund?

Absolutely. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, so you are well within the window. I can process a full refund for you right now. I'll just need to email you a prepaid return label.

That's great, I appreciate you approving the refund. Since I do need to buy another pair of cycling shoes, and this has been a bit of an inconvenience, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase with VeloFit?

I understand your position. However, since we are providing a full refund including a prepaid shipping label, I'm not able to add a separate discount code on top of that. My priority is to make this return process as easy as possible for you.

Okay, I see. How about this then? Instead of a cash refund, could you issue the amount as store credit and maybe add a small 10% bonus? That way, the money stays with VeloFit, and I'm encouraged to find the right pair.

That's a clever thought, but our system is set up to issue the refund directly to the original payment method only. We can't convert it to store credit or add any bonus amount. I have just sent that prepaid return label to the email on your account.
Alright, David, fair enough. I had to try. I see the email now. Thank you for handling this so quickly.
You are very welcome. We want to make sure you get the gear that's right for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
